rubric.role_summary: Product Marketing Manager driving launches, feature awareness and adoption for a collaborative AI workspace, while partnering with Product and go-to-market teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Product Marketing Manager driving launches, feature awareness and adoption for a collaborative AI workspace, while partnering with Product and go-to-market teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience running product launches and adoption programs.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a fast-moving product or technology company.
- Already uses Notion and is familiar with its product and community.
- Experience building and using agents inside Notion and beyond.
- Product marketing manager experience at a larger company.
- Cross-functional coordination skills involving Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
